chk_auth_sessions_subject_reference.name: chk_auth_sessions_subject_reference
chk_auth_sessions_subject_reference.value:
("auth_sessions"."subject_type" = 'family' and "auth_sessions"."family_account_id" is not null and "auth_sessions"."administrator_id" is null)
          or ("auth_sessions"."subject_type" = 'administrator' and "auth_sessions"."family_account_id" is null and "auth_sessions"."administrator_id" is not null)

chk_staff_schedule_months_confirmation.name: chk_staff_schedule_months_confirmation
chk_staff_schedule_months_confirmation.value: ("staff_schedule_months"."status" = 'draft' and "staff_schedule_months"."confirmed_at" is null) or ("staff_schedule_months"."status" = 'confirmed' and "staff_schedule_months"."confirmed_at" is not null)

chk_staff_schedule_preferences_payload.name: chk_staff_schedule_preferences_payload
chk_staff_schedule_preferences_payload.value:
("staff_schedule_preferences"."preference_type" = 'day_off' and "staff_schedule_preferences"."start_time" is null and "staff_schedule_preferences"."end_time" is null)
          or ("staff_schedule_preferences"."preference_type" = 'work_time'
            and "staff_schedule_preferences"."start_time" glob '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
            and "staff_schedule_preferences"."end_time" glob '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
            and substr("staff_schedule_preferences"."start_time", 4, 2) in ('00', '15', '30', '45')
            and substr("staff_schedule_preferences"."end_time", 4, 2) in ('00', '15', '30', '45')
            and "staff_schedule_preferences"."start_time" >= '06:30'
            and "staff_schedule_preferences"."end_time" <= '20:30'
            and "staff_schedule_preferences"."start_time" < "staff_schedule_preferences"."end_time")

chk_staff_schedule_segments_times.name: chk_staff_schedule_segments_times
chk_staff_schedule_segments_times.value:
"staff_schedule_segments"."start_time" glob '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
          and "staff_schedule_segments"."end_time" glob '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'
          and substr("staff_schedule_segments"."start_time", 4, 2) in ('00', '15', '30', '45')
          and substr("staff_schedule_segments"."end_time", 4, 2) in ('00', '15', '30', '45')
          and "staff_schedule_segments"."start_time" >= '06:30'
          and "staff_schedule_segments"."end_time" <= '20:30'
          and "staff_schedule_segments"."start_time" < "staff_schedule_segments"."end_time"

chk_staff_schedule_versions_confirmation.name: chk_staff_schedule_versions_confirmation
chk_staff_schedule_versions_confirmation.value: ("staff_schedule_versions"."status" = 'draft' and "staff_schedule_versions"."confirmed_at" is null) or ("staff_schedule_versions"."status" = 'confirmed' and "staff_schedule_versions"."confirmed_at" is not null)

chk_staff_weekly_availability_times.name: chk_staff_weekly_availability_times
chk_staff_weekly_availability_times.value:
("staff_weekly_availability"."available" = 0 and "staff_weekly_availability"."start_time" is null and "staff_weekly_availability"."end_time" is null)
          or ("staff_weekly_availability"."available" = 1 and "staff_weekly_availability"."start_time" is not null and "staff_weekly_availability"."end_time" is not null and "staff_weekly_availability"."start_time" < "staff_weekly_availability"."end_time")
